question: After the first 40, 60 or 80 point stretch from the 09:30 open, how often does price give back 5, 10 or 15 points toward the open before 09:45 Eastern?
continuation_barrier_points: threshold / 2 farther outward from the stretch level
event: First crossing of either opening band per threshold per day. If both are first touched in one minute, retain both admissible first-direction branches. A known minute open outside a band has first priority.
anchoring: Fixed nominal levels relative to the 09:30 open, not unknown actual trade fills or hindsight session extremes. Gap breaches remain in the sample. An opening gap beyond the continuation barrier is continuation-first for that branch.
ordering: Use all OHLC-consistent event order possibilities, including pre-trigger favorable extremes and arbitrary revisits. No fixed O-H-L-C or O-L-H-C path. Carry unresolved target/stop/live states; union both possible first directions. A close beyond the retracement level or the later opposite opening-band touch can prove an entry-minute retracement.
percentages: Guaranteed-event count / all triggered sessions to possible-event count / all triggered sessions. These are bounds from unresolved minute ordering, not confidence intervals or future probability guarantees. No-trigger sessions reported separately.
period_status: All periods have already been inspected in earlier work. Recent period is a descriptive stability comparison, not a fresh holdout.
breakdowns: known first-up and first-down direction with ambiguous first direction separate
evidence_rule: Report every one of the 9 fixed combinations, all exclusions and no-trigger counts. Flag n < 100; no selection, optimization or profitability pass/fail. No expansion after results.
completeness: Require all 15 observed minutes, one instrument_id, valid finite tick-aligned OHLC. No forward filling.
exclusions: Preserve excluded cash dates with reason and missing minutes. Calendar reused from the preserved NYSE cash-session study.
limits: Not a repeated-entry backtest or a trade win rate
No low-directional-progress filter tested; it requires reliable subminute history
No profit, costs, size or live execution evaluated
Unadjusted continuous MNQ series; original vendor request provenance not reconstructed
Does not assume a retracement from the final session high/low
Minute prices do not identify exact trigger trade time or executable fills

execution.method: Standalone preserved descriptive analysis; no official workbench run or promotion
